cards.title: Phishing / Spear Phishing / Vishing / Smishing
cards.description_short: Deceptive attempts to steal credentials or information
cards.description_long: Social engineering attacks exploit human trust rather than technical vulnerabilities. Phishing uses emails, spear phishing targets specific individuals, vishing uses phone calls, and smishing uses SMS messages to trick users into revealing sensitive information.

main_commands.explanation: Typical phishing attempt to steal credentials
Targeted email to a specific individual or role
Phone call to convince victim to provide credentials
Fake website used to capture user credentials

activity: Identify phishing emails in a controlled lab
Analyze spear phishing tactics for targeted attacks
Understand risks of vishing phone calls
Learn how to report phishing attempts safely

cards.title: Pretexting / Impersonation
cards.description_short: Create a believable scenario to extract information
cards.description_long: Pretexting involves fabricating a scenario to gain the victim's trust and extract sensitive information. Impersonation is physically or digitally posing as someone else to manipulate the target.

main_commands.explanation: Pretend to be a CEO/CFO to request sensitive info
Create a fake profile to trick contacts
Outline a believable story to engage victim
Gain physical access by posing as delivery or employee

activity: Create a safe pretext scenario in a lab
Evaluate risks of social media impersonation

cards.title: Malicious Email Attachments
cards.description_long: Attackers embed malware or malicious scripts in email attachments to compromise systems. Opening or executing these attachments can lead to infection, credential theft, or network compromise.

main_commands.explanation: Office documents with macros or exploits
Analyze attachment behavior safely without executing on main system

activity: Identify malicious attachments in controlled environment
Practice safe handling of unknown attachments
Understand how double extensions trick users
Use sandbox tools to analyze attachment behavior
